arxiv-2202-09888.title: Benchmarking the Linear Algebra Awareness of TensorFlow and PyTorch Thanks: Financial support from the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (German Research Foundation) through grants GSC 111 and IRTG 2379 is gratefully acknowledged.
arxiv-2202-09888.creator: Aravind Sankaran 1 , Navid Akbari Alashti 2 , and Christos Psarras 3, Paolo Bientinesi
arxiv-2202-09888.description: Abstract Linear algebra operations, which are ubiquitous in machine learning, form major performance bottlenecks. The High-Performance Computing community invests significant effort in the development of architecture-specific optimized kernels, such as those provided by the BLAS and LAPACK libraries, to speed up linear algebra operations.

arxiv-2303-03925.title: Robust Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection via Adversarially Learned Continuous Noise Corruption
arxiv-2303-03925.creator: Jack W. Barker 1 , Neelanjan Bhowmik 1 , Yona Falinie A. Gaus 1 and Toby P. Breckon 1,2 Department of { Computer Science 1 | | Engineering 2 } , Durham University, Durham, UK
arxiv-2303-03925.description: Abstract Anomaly detection is the task of recognising novel samples which deviate significantly from pre-established normality. Abnormal classes are not present during training meaning that models must learn effective representations solely across normal class data samples. Deep Autoencoders (AE) have been widely used for anomaly detection tasks, but suffer from overfitting to a null identity function.

arxiv-2303-14587.title: PAniC-3D: Stylized Single-view 3D Reconstruction from Portraits of Anime Characters
arxiv-2303-14587.creator: Shuhong Chen, Kevin Zhang, Yichun Shi, Heng Wang, Yiheng Zhu, Guoxian Song, Sizhe An, Janus Kristjansson, Xiao Yang, Matthias Zwicker, University of Maryland - College Park, MD, USA, ByteDance
arxiv-2303-14587.description: Abstract We propose PAniC-3D, a system to reconstruct stylized 3D character heads directly from illustrated (p)ortraits of (ani)me (c)haracters. Our anime-style domain poses unique challenges to single-view reconstruction; compared to natural images of human heads, character portrait illustrations have hair and accessories with more complex and diverse geometry, and are shaded with non-photorealistic contour lines.

arxiv-2403-00079.title: Representations of Kronecker Quivers and Steiner Bundles on Grassmannians
arxiv-2403-00079.creator: Daniel Bissinger and Rolf Farnsteiner
arxiv-2403-00079.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Daniel Bissinger and Rolf Farnsteiner. Let 𝕜 \mathbbm{k} be an algebraically closed field. Connections between representations of the generalized Kronecker quivers K r K_{r} and vector bundles on ℙ r − 1 \mathbb{P}^{r-1} have been known for quite some time.

arxiv-2404-17410.title: Scattered waves fuel emergent activity
arxiv-2404-17410.creator: Ella M. King*, Mia C. Morrell*, Jacqueline B. Sustiel, Matthew Gronert, Hayden Pastor, David G. Grier
arxiv-2404-17410.description: Abstract Active matter taps into external energy sources to power its own processes. Systems of passive particles ordinarily lack this capacity, but can become active if the constituent particles interact with each other nonreciprocally. By reformulating the theory of classical wave-matter interactions, we demonstrate that interactions mediated by scattered waves generally are not constrained by Newton’s third law.

arxiv-2405-08891.title: Noncommutative resolution of 𝒮 ​ U C ​ ( 2 ) \mathcal{S}U_{C}(2)
arxiv-2405-08891.creator: Elias Sink and Jenia Tevelev
arxiv-2405-08891.description: Abstract . We study the derived category of the moduli space 𝒮 ​ U C ​ ( 2 ) \mathcal{S}U_{C}(2) of rank 2 2 vector bundles on a smooth projective curve C C of genus g ≥ 2 g\geq 2 with trivial determinant. This generalizes the recent work by Tevelev and Torres on the case with fixed odd determinant.

arxiv-2405-16236.title: A transfer learning framework for weak to strong generalization
arxiv-2405-16236.creator: Seamus Somerstep Felipe Maia Polo Moulinath Banerjee Ya’acov Ritov Mikhail Yurochkin Yuekai Sun
arxiv-2405-16236.description: Abstract Modern large language model (LLM) alignment techniques rely on human feedback, but it is unclear whether these techniques fundamentally limit the capabilities of aligned LLMs. In particular, it is unknown if it is possible to align (stronger) LLMs with superhuman capabilities with (weaker) human feedback without degrading their capabilities .

arxiv-2410-16784.title: 3SUM in Preprocessed Universes: Faster and Simpler Thanks: Work supported by European Research Council (ERC) under the EU’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme (Grant agreement No. 101019547).
arxiv-2410-16784.creator: Shashwat Kasliwal, Adam Polak, Pratyush Sharma
arxiv-2410-16784.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shashwat Kasliwal, Adam Polak, Pratyush Sharma. We revisit the 3SUM problem in the preprocessed universes setting. We present an algorithm that, given three sets A A , B B , C C of n n integers, preprocesses them in quadratic time, so that given any subsets A ′ ⊆ A A^{\prime}\subseteq A , B ′ ⊆ B B^{\prime}\subseteq B , C ′ ⊆ C C^{\prime}\subseteq C , it can decide if there exist a ∈ A ′ a\in A^{\prime} , b ∈ B ′

arxiv-2502-04646.title: Efficient Weighted Sampling via Score-based Generative Models
arxiv-2502-04646.creator: Heasung Kim, Taekyun Lee, Hyeji Kim, Gustavo de Veciana
arxiv-2502-04646.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Heasung Kim, Taekyun Lee, Hyeji Kim, Gustavo de Veciana. Weighted sampling—sampling from a probability density function (PDF) proportional to the product of a base PDF and a weight function—is a fundamental technique with wide-ranging applications in variance reduction, biased sampling, data augmentation, and more.

pmc-10753958.creator: David Veale, Marc Serfaty, Clara Humpston, Adriana Papageorgiou, Sarah Markham, John Hodsoll, Allan H Young
pmc-10753958.description: rvention. Twelve additional participants were mistakenly randomised after screening. They were lost and had not consented to participate. pmc-11511832.title: Estimating Students’ Academic Success in the Preclinical Stage of Undergraduate Medical Education Using the Admission Test Approach
pmc-11511832.creator: WIENTA DIARSVITRI, EFYLUK GARIANTO, ROOSTANTIA INDRAWATI, WIWIK SULISTIANI
pmc-11511832.description: Introduction: Medical schools face substantial challenges in objectively selecting the best applicants, and the admission process can impact medical students’ academic performance. This study aimed to estimate the students’ academic success in the preclinical stage of undergraduate medical education using admission tests.Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted on 1,193 students’ records from the 2014 to 2019 cohorts.

pmc-11668499.title: New York State Climate Impacts Assessment Chapter 08: Society and Economy
pmc-11668499.creator: Luis Aguirre‐Torres, Robin Leichenko, Mary Austerman, Deborah Balk, Hallie E Bond, Riobart E Breen, David Burgy, Cassandra John, Franchelle Parker, Kenneth Schlather, Amanda Stevens
pmc-11668499.description: Climate change is affecting or will affect the lives of every resident of New York State. This chapter examines the impacts of climate change on five critical areas in the state: populations and migration, the economy, education, culture, and government.

pmc-12479355.title: Distinct roles for B cell-derived LTα3 and LTα1β2 in TNF-mediated ileitis
pmc-12479355.creator: Emma C Erlich, Quazim A Alayo, Ayoung Kim, Jichang Han, Rachel L Mintz, Christopher G Huckstep, Heather S Ruiz, Rachael L Field, Taylor J Dunning, Leila S Saleh, Mark H Hoofnagle, Alexei V Tumanov, Farshid Guilak, Jonathan R Brestoff, Rafael S Czepielewski, Gwendalyn J Randolph
pmc-12479355.description: Crohn’s disease pathology is modeled in TNFΔARE+/− mice that overproduce tumor necrosis factor (TNF) to drive disease through TNF receptors. An alternative ligand for TNF receptors, soluble LTα3, is produced by B cells, but has received scarce attention because LTα also partners with LTβ to generate membrane-tethered LTαβ2 that promotes tertiary lymphoid tissue—another feature of Crohn’s disease.

pmc-12580330.title: Water-detected NMR allows dynamic observations of repeat-expansion RNA condensates
pmc-12580330.creator: Johannes Schmoll, Mihajlo Novakovic, Frédéric H-T Allain
pmc-12580330.description: RNA condensation is implicated in the formation of neurotoxic RNA foci in cells affected by genomic expansions of trinucleotide or hexanucleotide repeats. However, the biophysical properties of repeat-expansion RNA condensates are poorly understood. Using CAG repeat-expansion RNA as a model system, we show that these RNA condensates cannot be observed with conventional nuclear magnetic resonance techniques.

pmc-12734304.title: Lightweight 3D CNN for MRI Analysis in Alzheimer’s Disease: Balancing Accuracy and Efficiency
pmc-12734304.creator: Kerang Cao, Zhongqing Lu, Chengkui Zhao, Jiaming Du, Lele Li, Hoekyung Jung, Minghui Geng, Gongyang Li, Mrinal Mandal, Xiaofei Zhou, Yong Wu
pmc-12734304.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by subtle structural changes in the brain, which can be observed through MRI scans. Although traditional diagnostic approaches rely on clinical and neuropsychological assessments, deep learning-based methods such as 3D convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have recently been introduced to improve diagnostic accuracy. However, their high computational complexity remains a challenge.

pmc-12749894.title: Association of surrogate indices of insulin resistance with hypertension: a cross-sectional analysis from PERSIAN Dena cohort study (PDCS)
pmc-12749894.creator: Amirhossein Hosseini, Behrooz Ebrahimzadehkour, Mohammad-Reza Jowshan
pmc-12749894.description: Early detection of hypertension remains challenging due to its asymptomatic nature and limited screening tools. While surrogate indices of insulin resistance (IR) have emerged as potential screening tools for various metabolic disorders, their predictive value for hypertension remains unclear, particularly in different demographic groups.

pmc-12960325.title: Toward Effective Technology Support in DCTs: Insights from the Trials@Home Proof-of-Concept Trial RADIAL
pmc-12960325.creator: Theresa Weitlaner, Dimitrios Giannikopoulos, Bart Lagerwaard, Hannes Hilberger, Bernhard Neumayer, Mira G. P. Zuidgeest, Sten Hanke
pmc-12960325.description: Decentralized clinical trials (DCTs) increasingly rely on digital tools such as wearable devices, mobile applications, and online platforms to enable remote data collection and participant engagement. While these technologies offer opportunities for greater convenience and continuous data capture, they also introduce operational complexity and require comprehensive technical support for participants, clinical site staff, and study teams.

pmc-13143129.title: Effects of Repetitive Peripheral Magnetic Stimulation on Hemodynamics Compared to Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation
pmc-13143129.creator: Takeru ECHIZEN, Shoki YUSU, Urara CHIBA, Tomoyuki MORISAWA, Masakazu SAITOH, Kotaro IWATSU, Tetsuya TAKAHASHI
pmc-13143129.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesThis study aimed to compare the effects of repetitive peripheral magnetic stimulation (rPMS) and neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) on hemodynamics and obtain basic data to verify the safety of rPMS in healthy adults.MethodsrPMS and NMES were performed for 5 min in the supine position using a maximum-intensity stimulation that did not cause pain in the quadriceps femoris of 20 healthy adult males.

pmc-13223276.title: Comparative exposure and risk assessment of heavy metals, nutrients, and organochlorine pesticides in cow and plant-based milks
pmc-13223276.creator: Sonya Good, Chukwunonso Anakwue, Tuan Phan
pmc-13223276.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cow milk and plant-based milk alternatives (PBMAs) are widely consumed beverages, yet both can act as pathways for exposure to environmental contaminants originating from soil, water, and legacy agricultural practices. In this study, we quantified heavy metals (lead (Pb), cadmium (Cd), chromium (Cr), and arsenic (As)), macro- and micronutrients, and 24 organochlorine pesticides (OCPs) in cow milk and seven PBMAs (almond, soy, oat, coconut, hemp, rice, and cashew).

pmc-13375207.title: Physical Activity Monitoring Using Wearable Devices in Young Adults: Secondary Analysis of a 6-Month Motivational Interviewing Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13375207.creator: Nicolette Christodoulakis, Taylor Incze, Sahar Khademioore, Matthew Kwan, Elizabeth Alvarez, Jean-Éric Tarride, Lawrence Mbuagbaw, Laura N Anderson
pmc-13375207.description: In this secondary analysis of a pilot randomized controlled trial of university students aged 18 to 29 years, we assessed the feasibility of providing wearable devices to measure physical activity over 6 months, finding that daily adherence declined over time in both groups, while moderate and vigorous physical activity levels remained similar between the control and intervention groups.

pmc-13399713.title: The Presence of Chondral Pathology Is Not Associated With an Increase in Meniscal Root Retear, Reoperation, or Subsequent Total Knee Arthroplasty Rates
pmc-13399713.creator: Matthew D Benson, Richard J VanTienderen, Austin C Benson, Benjamin D Packard, Steven M Leary, Kyle R Duchman, Brian R Wolf, Robert W Westermann
pmc-13399713.description: PurposeTo identify whether chondral pathology is associated with an increase in failure rates of isolated meniscal root repairs.MethodsWe retrospectively reviewed meniscus repairs from 2012 to 2022 at the author's institution. Nonroot repairs and cases with total or same compartment meniscectomy, cartilage restoration, osteotomy, or other concurrent ligament repair or reconstruction were excluded.

pmc-13468312.title: Identifying and Managing Pre-Myopia: A Narrative Review
pmc-13468312.creator: Amy H Y Chow, Deborah A Jones, Brie M McConnell, Natalia Vlasak, Rakhee Shah
pmc-13468312.description: BackgroundProactive management of children at risk of developing myopia (pre-myopia) can be more impactful than treatment after onset. The aim of this narrative review is to identify risk factors associated with pre-myopia, explore predictors of myopia development in pre-myopic children, and discuss effective prevention strategies.

pmc-13515665.title: Ethnic Differences in Pregnancy Complications Among Women with Gestational Diabetes
pmc-13515665.creator: Tiziana Filardi, Paola Galoppi, Stefania Gorini, Ilenia Mappa, Giuseppe Rizzo, Susanna Morano
pmc-13515665.description: Background/Objectives: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) is a metabolic disorder associated with an amplified risk of unfavorable pregnancy outcomes. This study aimed to compare clinical characteristics and pregnancy outcomes among GDM patients belonging to different ethnic groups. Patients and Methods: This retrospective analysis included n = 466 women with GDM (n = 167 Asian; n = 299 European).
